data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Tobiah, meaning 'God is good'. This name is used in the Old Testament and appears in the Bible books of Nehemiah and Tobit. The story of Tobit tells of the angel Raphael, who helps Tobie recover his sight and find true love. The name Tobie carries the meaning “God is good” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tobie usually hope their child will grow to embody god is good and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tobie total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: The name Tobie carries a rich cultural heritage through its biblical origins. It is a representation of the Hebrew people, their language, and their ancient traditions. Therefore, bearing the name Tobie is a constant reminder of the divine goodness that permeates life.
